title: Create an Issue and Auto-Close It via PR
description: Create an Issue on your `hcc-git-practice` repository, build a fix on a feature branch, and auto-close the issue by linking it in your Pull Request.
steps: Go to your `hcc-git-practice` repository on GitHub and click the 'Issues' tab
Click 'New issue' — Title: `Add project license to repository`
Description: `We need an open-source MIT license file in the root directory.`
Click 'Submit new issue' — note the issue number (e.g., `#1`)
In your local terminal: `git switch main && git pull`
Create a file `LICENSE` containing: `MIT License - Copyright (c) 2026 HCC Learner`
Stage and commit: `git add LICENSE && git commit -m "chore: add MIT license"`
Open a PR on GitHub — in the description write: `Closes #1` (replace with your issue number!)
Merge the Pull Request — go back to the Issues tab and observe that Issue #1 was closed automatically!
expected_output: Issue shows closed with the purple badge: 'closed by pull request #...' automatically.
tips: Auto-closing issues saves teams from manually cleaning up tickets after shipping code.
